Stock market news | Supriya Lifescience plans share buyback at December 2 board meeting

Supriya Lifescience said its board will meet on December 2, 2026 to consider a proposal to buy back its fully paid-up equity shares, pending statutory and regulatory approvals.

The move comes after the company reported a 42% profit decline to ₹29.25 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue grew 3.2% to ₹206.30 crore, reflecting margin pressure from product-mix changes and higher input costs.
